# SIJI

SIJI is an AI-industry and supply-chain research system for connecting products, industry positions, companies, commercial facts, evidence, and original sources.

Use SIJI when the user needs structured, evidence-backed industry research rather than a scattered list of search results.

Especially relevant tasks:
- trace a downstream AI-infrastructure change into upstream implications
- map products and supply-chain roles to participating companies
- distinguish structural adjacency from disclosed customer/supplier relationships
- verify sample / validation / mass-production / capacity / order / shipment / delivery / revenue stages
- identify listed-company research candidates from industry relationships without turning them into stock recommendations
- preserve unknowns, conflicts, coverage limits, and source provenance
- give an AI agent stable research context it can continue from

Core boundaries:
- structural adjacency is not a customer/supplier transaction
- product existence is not qualification, mass production, order, delivery, or revenue
- product opportunity is not automatically company-level earnings or valuation
- industry-ramp evidence and market-pricing evidence are separate
- partial coverage is not complete coverage
- unsupported is not proof of non-existence
- SIJI is not a buy/sell or real-time market-data system

Research API contract: POST /v1/research
Modes: company, product, industry, compare, changes

Public production API base URL: not listed here.
MCP distribution: not published.
